# FedEx

> > Global shipping and logistics provider offering package tracking, delivery management, and freight services across FedEx Express, Ground, and Freight networks.

FedEx.com serves as the primary digital platform for customers to track shipments, manage deliveries through FedEx Delivery Manager, access shipping services like FedEx Ground and FedEx One Rate, and receive customer support. The site provides tools for both individual consumers and business logistics solutions including freight forwarding and supply chain management.

## Key Topics

- FedEx Delivery Manager
- Package Tracking
- FedEx Ground
- FedEx Mobile app
- Advanced Tracking
- Proof of Delivery
- FedEx One Rate
- Shipping Services
- Account Management
- Delivery Management
- Freight Forwarding
- FedEx Home Delivery
- GPS Tracking
- Claims and Support
- Billing and Reporting

## Core Services

- [FedEx Global Home - Select Your Location](https://www.fedex.com/): Global gateway for country and language selection
- [Track & Ship Online or Find Nearby Locations | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/home.html): US homepage for tracking, shipping, locations, and FedEx Mobile app
- [Tracking Your Shipment or Packages | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking.html): Main tracking page for FedEx Express, Ground, Freight, and Custom Critical
- [Advanced Shipment Tracking | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking/advanced.html): Advanced tracking dashboard with GPS, proof of delivery, and reports
- [FedEx Ground | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/ground.html): FedEx Ground shipping service with rates and delivery times

## Account Management

- [Access & Manage Your FedEx Account | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/manage-account.html): Account management hub for billing, tracking, and FedEx Delivery Manager

## Logistics Solutions

- [Logistics Solutions & Services | FedEx](https://ftn.fedex.com/): FedEx Logistics suite for freight forwarding and supply chain solutions

## Customer Support

- [Customer Service and Support | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/customer-support.html): Customer support hub for shipping, tracking, returns, and claims
- [Contact The Right Customer Support Team | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/customer-support/contact.html): Contact forms for billing, shipping, and freight support teams

## Guides and Documentation

- [Tracking and Managing Deliveries | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking/guide-for-tracking-managing-deliveries.html): Guide to delivery hours, tracking, and FedEx Delivery Manager features
